'''Kabalian''' was the native language of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], month-long riots in the capital city of [[Shoribus]] begun due to planet-wide food shortages, and were only ended when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] dropped parcels of rations and other food stuff within the city. The Separatist freighters seized this opportunity to voice anti-Republic war propaganda in both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and Kabalian.
